title: ResourceRequirement
description: A rusl.bundle.toml [rusl.resources] value. The string form is a version requirement. The object form adds optional local ownership (dev) so install and cache clear will not delete or overwrite the on-disk schema file.

oneOf.description: Version requirement for a registry-managed resource. Examples: *, >=1.2.3, 1.2.3.

version.description: Version requirement used when resolving this resource from the registry. Defaults to * when omitted.

dev.description: When true, rusl still resolves the resource and may download it if the local file is missing, but will not delete or overwrite an existing on-disk schema file.
